cover_shows_face.instructions: Is a person's face clearly visible in the image?

criteria.true: At least one human face can be seen clearly.
criteria.false: No human face is shown, or it is hidden, turned away or too small to make out.

cover_has_text.instructions: Is there text overlaid on the image, such as a title or caption?

criteria.true: Words have been added on top of the picture.
criteria.false: There is no added text. Words that are part of the scene, like a sign or a logo, do not count.

cover_text_readable.instructions: Is there overlaid text large enough to read at a glance on a phone screen?

criteria.true: The added text is large, with clear contrast, and can be read in a second.
criteria.false: There is no added text, or it is small, crowded or hard to read.

cover_text_short.instructions: Is there overlaid text of seven words or fewer?

criteria.true: The added text is seven words or fewer in all.
criteria.false: There is no added text, or it runs to more than seven words.

cover_one_subject.instructions: Does the image have one clear main subject?

criteria.true: One person, animal or object clearly dominates the frame.
criteria.false: Several things compete for attention, or nothing stands out.

cover_close_up.instructions: Is the main subject shown in close-up?

criteria.true: The main subject fills most of the frame.
criteria.false: The subject is small in the frame, or the shot is wide.

cover_in_action.instructions: Does the image show something happening, rather than a posed or still subject?

criteria.true: The subject is caught in the middle of an action or movement.
criteria.false: The subject is posed, standing still or at rest.

cover_looks_at_camera.instructions: Is a person looking straight at the camera?

criteria.true: A person's eyes meet the viewer.
criteria.false: No person is shown, or they look elsewhere.

cover_strong_emotion.instructions: Does a person in the image show a strong facial expression?

criteria.true: A person shows clear surprise, joy, anger, fear or effort.
criteria.false: No person is shown, or their expression is neutral.

cover_bright.instructions: Is the image bright and well lit?

criteria.true: The picture is bright, and its subject is easy to see.
criteria.false: The picture is dark, dim or murky.

cover_plain_background.instructions: Is the background plain or uncluttered?

criteria.true: The background is simple, blurred or a single tone.
criteria.false: The background is busy or full of detail.

cover_is_graphic.instructions: Is the image a designed graphic, a screenshot or a collage, rather than a single photo or video frame?

criteria.true: It was assembled or designed: a graphic, a screenshot, or several pictures combined.
criteria.false: It is one photo or one frame of video.
